description: Gives the number of risers allowed for a total rise, the rise and run of each option, and tests headroom and width against Ontario Building Code Part 9 Section 9.8. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/stair-calculator-ontario?units=mm&type=private&rise=2600&run=3500&headroom=1980&width=900

rise.description: Total rise from finished floor to finished floor (units)

type.description: private = stairs inside or outside a house or dwelling unit; public = public stairs in a residential building

units.description: Units of rise, run, headroom and width

name: stair-calculator-ontario
title: Stair calculator for Ontario
